title: Pip and the Strange Pie
checkpoint: Year 1 Autumn 1, week 1 — School readiness — Phase 5: new sounds ay, ou, ie
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5, 79-sound stage (ay, ou, ie just added).

pages.text: Pip spots a round thing in the grass.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tilting his head at an unfamiliar round shape in the grass.

pages.text: It is round and has a crust.
pages.illustration: Close view of a round pastry pie with a golden crust, sitting in the grass.

pages.text: Pip taps it with his bill.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow tapping the crust gently with his bill.
Pip the sparrow pecking off a small bit of the crust.
Pip the sparrow pausing, surprised by the sweet taste.

pages.text: Pip thinks it may be a pie.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking closely at the filling inside the crust.

pages.text: Pip has one last bit of pie.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow pecking another bit from the pie, looking pleased.

pages.text: Pip is glad he got the pie.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing beside the pie, clearly delighted.

pages.text: Pip will stay near the pie all day.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow perched protectively right next to the pie.

pages.text: Pip naps next to the last bit of pie.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow asleep beside the last small bit of pie.
